description: Discover Alibaba Cloud Simple Log Service Projects and Logstores, query logs and histograms, and aggregate Project discovery across selected regions.

fields.label: Access Key ID
fields.description: The Alibaba Cloud RAM AccessKey ID used to call Simple Log Service. Use a RAM identity with only the required SLS permissions.

fields.label: Access Key Secret
fields.description: The AccessKey secret from the same Alibaba Cloud RAM AccessKey pair.

fields.label: Default Regional Endpoint
fields.description: The default regional Simple Log Service endpoint used by actions that omit endpoint, for example cn-hangzhou.log.aliyuncs.com.

fields.label: Security Token
fields.description: An optional Alibaba Cloud STS security token used with temporary AccessKey credentials.

fields.label: Resource Scope
fields.description: Optional connector-local resource allowlist as a JSON array. Leave it blank to set no local resource restriction and use list_projects and list_logstores to discover resources allowed by RAM. Each item requires project; endpoint is optional and defaults to the connection endpoint. Omitting logstores allows every Logstore in that Project. When logstores is provided, it must contain only non-empty, unique Logstore names and only those Logstores are accessible. This local allowlist does not replace Alibaba Cloud RAM permissions.

actions.name: get_histograms
actions.description: Query the time distribution of matching logs in one Simple Log Service Logstore.

endpoint.description: The regional Simple Log Service endpoint, such as cn-hangzhou.log.aliyuncs.com. Defaults to the endpoint configured on the connection.

project.description: The Simple Log Service Project name. It may be omitted only when the connection resource scope has exactly one candidate Project for the selected endpoint.

logstore.description: The Simple Log Service Logstore name. It may be omitted only when the selected Project has exactly one allowed Logstore in the connection resource scope.

from.description: The inclusive start of the query interval as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Simple Log Service evaluates [from, to).

to.description: The exclusive end of the query interval as a Unix timestamp in seconds. It must be greater than from.

query.description: An optional Simple Log Service search or analytic statement.

inputSchema.description: The Logstore target, time range, and search statement for a histogram query.

endpoint.description: The regional endpoint queried by this action.

project.description: The Project queried by this action.

logstore.description: The Logstore queried by this action.

progress.description: The overall Simple Log Service histogram query progress.

count.description: The total number of matching logs across the returned intervals.

from.description: The inclusive interval start as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

to.description: The exclusive interval end as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

count.description: The number of matching logs in this interval.

progress.description: The query progress for this interval.

histograms.description: The stable histogram intervals returned by Simple Log Service.

actions.name: query_logs
actions.description: Query logs from one Simple Log Service Logstore with the GetLogs API.

endpoint.description: The regional Simple Log Service endpoint, such as cn-hangzhou.log.aliyuncs.com. Defaults to the endpoint configured on the connection.

project.description: The Simple Log Service Project name. It may be omitted only when the connection resource scope has exactly one candidate Project for the selected endpoint.

logstore.description: The Simple Log Service Logstore name. It may be omitted only when the selected Project has exactly one allowed Logstore in the connection resource scope.

from.description: The inclusive start of the query interval as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Simple Log Service evaluates [from, to).

to.description: The exclusive end of the query interval as a Unix timestamp in seconds. It must be greater than from.

query.description: An optional Simple Log Service search or analytic statement.

offset.description: The starting row for a search query.

line.description: The maximum number of logs to return. Simple Log Service accepts 0 to 100.

reverse.description: Whether search results should be returned newest first.

powerSql.description: Whether to use the Simple Log Service Exclusive SQL feature.

inputSchema.description: The Logstore target, time range, query, and GetLogs pagination controls.

endpoint.description: The regional endpoint queried by this action.

project.description: The Project queried by this action.

logstore.description: The Logstore queried by this action.

progress.description: The Simple Log Service query progress, such as Complete or Incomplete.

count.description: The number of log entries returned.

anyOf.description: The number of rows processed by the query, or null when unavailable.
